pluginWords.job.Identity: a way to log in — the login page is built from these
pluginWords.job.Input: a way of entering items in the propose dialog
pluginWords.job.Identifier: one identifier type — recognises, checks and normalises a value, and names it
pluginWords.job.Harvester: finds new documents and proposes them
pluginWords.job.CatalogAdapter: reads catalog records — page counts, material type, units
pluginWords.job.PropertySource: supplies a value when the catalog has none
pluginWords.job.Registry: asks whether a copy already exists somewhere
pluginWords.job.Validation: checks a record is complete enough to digitize
pluginWords.job.Restriction: forbids digitizing — copyright, embargo; only an admin overrules it
pluginWords.job.Classifier: suggests the category a proposal is decided under
pluginWords.job.ListGenerator: builds a digitization list for an intention
pluginWords.job.Link: turns a PID or a viewer's address pasted into Set link… into the canonical link
pluginWords.job.PublicationDetector: finds where a scanned item was published and sets its link
pluginWords.job.Message: where Message… hands a conversation off to — mail, chat
pluginWords.job.DeliveryChannel: where a hook can send — email, chat, webhook, file
pluginActs.newKind: A new {{kind}}: nothing runs until an instance of it is made.
pluginWords.loss.catalogAdapter: {{name}} can no longer be searched when proposing, and its records stop resyncing.
pluginWords.loss.registry: existing-copy checks against {{name}} stop, and the registry states it reported go stale.
pluginWords.loss.propertySource: values it already supplied stay; new documents get none from it.
pluginWords.loss.validation: its rules stop running on ingest; defects it already found stay.
pluginWords.loss.restriction: it stops forbidding anything new. What it already forbade stays forbidden until a re-check clears it or an admin overrules it.
pluginWords.loss.custody: the {{count}} {{noun}} it places now are placed again without its rule; what nothing else places lands in the fallback.
pluginWords.loss.identifier: its type is no longer recognised as it is typed: it is read only when chosen, and the catalog lookup checks it.
pluginWords.loss.inputOthers: another instance still offers this way of entering items.
pluginWords.loss.inputLast: this way of entering items disappears from the propose dialog.
pluginWords.loss.generatorOthers: it disappears from Generate; other generators stay.
pluginWords.loss.generatorLast: it is the last generator: the Generate button disappears from Digitization Lists.
pluginWords.loss.linkOthers: Set link… stops reading its addresses; the others still read theirs.
pluginWords.loss.linkLast: Set link… takes only a full web address, kept as typed.
pluginWords.loss.publicationDetector: it stops setting links; links it already set stay.
pluginWords.loss.identity: it leaves the login page. {{sign}} in through it; they keep their records but cannot log in this way, and roles it mapped stay until their next login elsewhere.
pluginWords.loss.messageOthers: Message… stops offering it; other ways stay.
pluginWords.loss.messageLast: it is the last one: Message… disappears everywhere.
pluginWords.loss.channelNoHooks: no active hook sends through it.
pluginWords.loss.classifierOthers: the decide form stops showing its suggestions; the others still suggest.
pluginWords.loss.classifierLast: it is the last classifier: the decider picks a category with no suggestion.
pluginWords.loss.channelHooks_one: {{count}} active hook sending through it stops{{hooks}}; waiting deliveries resume when the channel is enabled again.
pluginWords.loss.channelHooks_other: {{count}} active hooks sending through it stop{{hooks}}; waiting deliveries resume when the channel is enabled again.
pluginActs.sameDeclarations: It declares the same names and fields.
pluginDrawers.custodyDeleted: Its custody was deleted: it places nothing until another is picked.
pluginDrawers.noneConfigured: None: it does nothing until one is configured.
pluginDrawers.manualTierAfter: is tier 100 and reserved: a person who looked outranks every plugin.
pluginDrawers.noDeclarations: Nothing it declares beyond doing its job.
pluginDrawers.rolesGivenByHand: None: roles are given by hand on Users & Groups.
pluginDrawers.roleClaimAppliedAtLogin: Applied at every login: a role holds while its claim does.
instanceEditor.name: Name
instanceEditor.catalogBasesHint: Empty reads every record. Separate with spaces: MZK01 MZK03.
instanceEditor.validationBases: A base is three or four capital letters and two digits, such as MZK01.
instanceEditor.noRole: No role: they see “no access yet”
instanceEditor.firstIdentifierWins: the first that recognises a value gives its type
instanceEditor.agentHint: what it proposes is logged as it
pluginWords.loss.custody_one: the {{count}} open proposal it places now is placed again without its rule; what nothing else places lands in the fallback.
pluginWords.loss.custody_other: the {{count}} open proposals it places now are placed again without its rule; what nothing else places lands in the fallback.
pluginTable.custodyDeleted: Its custody was deleted: it places nothing
pluginTable.noInstanceConfigured: No instance — it does nothing until one is configured.
pluginsPage.title: Plugins
pluginsPage.refusalDisabled: It is disabled; enable it first.
pluginsPage.refusalNotRunnable: It runs only while somebody uses it.
pluginsPage.refusalContract: Its version was built for a contract VERA does not run.
pluginsPage.enabledText: It runs from its next trigger.
pluginDrawers.custodyFinePrint: A proposal its condition matches is in this custody; what no rule places lands in the fallback.
pluginDrawers.otherContract: A version built for another contract is installed but never runs: VERA runs contract 1.x.
pluginDrawers.propertyFinePrint: Each instance's default; an instance sets its own. The highest tier with a value wins.
pluginDrawers.unmappedFinePrint: An unmapped value shown verbatim costs a curator one moment of unfamiliarity; a wrong mapping tells every curator something false, silently.
pluginDrawers.name: Name
pluginDrawers.agentProposals: What it finds goes through review, attributed to the agent.
pluginDrawers.agentAdditions: What it finds skips review: created already approved, attributed to the agent.
pluginDrawers.rulesFinePrint: A rule code stays stable between versions: renumbering one would silently invalidate every approval made against it.
pluginDrawers.generatorAi: {{class}}: gives its own reason for every pick; not deterministic
pluginDrawers.generatorRule: {{class}}: the same pool gives the same list
pluginDrawers.disabledFinePrint: It keeps its configuration and runs nowhere.
pluginDrawers.expiredRun: Last run {{date}}; its run has expired from Tasks.
pluginDrawers.noRole: no role: they see “no access yet”
pluginDrawers.matchEmailYes: yes: a verified address joins an existing user
pluginDrawers.messageOrder: Message… offers the instances in this order.
pluginDrawers.identifierOrder: A pasted value is tried against the identifier types in this order; the first that recognises it gives its type.
pluginDrawers.classifierOrder: Asked in this order; the first suggestion wins, and the decide form names who made it.
instanceEditor.refusalNameTaken: Another instance of it has that name.
instanceEditor.refusalClaimFixed: The user id claim is fixed once people sign in through it.
instanceEditor.refusalLastIdentity: It is the last way to log in; enable another first.
instanceEditor.refusalPolicy: Its tiers, copy states or agent do not fit what its version declares.
instanceEditor.refusalCustody: Pick a request custody on Users & Groups.
instanceEditor.refusalIdentifier: The type, pattern, normalisation (trim, upperCase, dropHyphens) or checksum (isbn10, isbn13, issn) is not one VERA reads.
instanceEditor.refusalIdentifierTaken: Another instance already recognises that identifier type.
instanceEditor.refusalForbidden: Only those who configure plugins change them.
instanceEditor.validationName: An instance needs a name: its runs are listed under it.
instanceEditor.validationTier: A tier is a whole number from 0 to {{max}}; manual alone is 100.
instanceEditor.validationCustody: Pick the custody a proposal it matches is in.
instanceEditor.validationMapping: Write each as "claim → role"; {{role}} is not a role.
instanceEditor.description: The configuration of an instance of {{name}}
instanceEditor.createdText: Enabled: it runs from its next trigger.
instanceEditor.secretPlaceholder: ••• set: leave blank to keep it
instanceEditor.claimFixedText: fixed once people sign in through it
instanceEditor.matchByEmailHint: A verified address joins the user who already has it, instead of making a new one.
instanceEditor.mappingFinePrint: Applied at each person's next login: a role holds while its claim does.
instanceEditor.custodyFinePrint: A proposal its condition matches is in this custody. Renaming the custody changes nothing; what no rule places lands in the fallback.
instanceEditor.tierFinePrint: The highest tier with a value wins; manual is 100, above every plugin.
instanceEditor.copyFinePrint: A copy blocks nothing: it is news for whoever decides.
instanceEditor.scheduleFinePrint: When it runs by itself is set on Schedules, once it exists.
pluginActs.resetDescription: Its cursors are cleared, so the next run reads the catalog from the start and rebuilds the mirror. Nothing in VERA's documents changes.
pluginActs.resetShort: Its cursors are cleared, so the next run reads from the start.
pluginActs.refusalNoCursor: This instance keeps no cursor to reset.
pluginActs.schedulesDeleted_one: Its {{count}} schedule on Schedules goes with it.
pluginActs.schedulesDeleted_other: Its {{count}} schedules on Schedules go with it.
pluginActs.deletedHistory_one: Its {{count}} run on Tasks stays until retention removes it. What it already wrote stays in each record’s history. To stop it for a while, disable it instead.
pluginActs.deletedHistory_other: Its {{count}} runs on Tasks stay until retention removes them. What it already wrote stays in each record’s history. To stop it for a while, disable it instead.
pluginActs.deletedHistoryNone: What it already wrote stays in each record’s history. To stop it for a while, disable it instead.
pluginActs.disabledWithSchedules: Its configuration and history stay, and its schedules are skipped rather than deleted. Enable it again at any time.
pluginActs.disabledWithoutSchedules: Its configuration and history stay. Enable it again at any time.
pluginActs.deleteDescription: What deleting the plugin instance {{name}} stops
pluginActs.disableDescription: What disabling the plugin instance {{name}} stops
pluginActs.upToDate: It runs the newest version already.
pluginActs.moveVersion: It moves from v{{from}} to v{{to}}.
pluginActs.retireRule_one: Retires {{name}}: defects under it are no longer reported, so {{count}} approval made against it covers nothing.
pluginActs.retireRule_other: Retires {{name}}: defects under it are no longer reported, so {{count}} approvals made against it cover nothing.
pluginActs.retireRuleNone: Retires {{name}}: defects under it are no longer reported.
pluginActs.dropField: Drops the field {{key}}, and the value it had.
pluginActs.addField: Adds the field {{key}}, empty until it is filled.
pluginActs.moveDescription: What moving {{name}} to a newer version changes
pluginActs.refusalPackage: A plugin comes as a .jar package.
pluginActs.refusalDescriptor: VERA found no plugin descriptor in it: is it a VERA plugin?
pluginActs.refusalUploadForbidden: Only those who upload plugin code may.
pluginActs.packageFinePrint: The package declares its type and what it supplies; VERA reads it before anything is installed, and nothing runs until an instance of it is made.
pluginActs.versionFinePrint: Currently v{{version}}. What the new version declares is compared with it before it is installed; no instance moves with it.
pluginActs.uploadDescription: Upload a plugin package; VERA reads what it declares before installing it
pluginActs.noInstanceUntilMade: It does nothing until an instance of it is made.
pluginActs.instancesStayVersion: Its instances stay on the version they run until each is moved.
pluginActs.unrunnableContract: VERA runs contract 1.x: it can be installed, but no instance of it can be enabled.
pluginActs.newVersionSummary: A new version of {{name}}, now at v{{version}}. No instance moves with it: each is moved on its own, after the same comparison.
pluginActs.retiredRuleSummary: Retires {{name}}: accepted defects under it are no longer reported, so their approvals have nothing to cover.
